title: 桜花賞の後に・芽生え

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Yes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (I did it! I showed ev'ryone what I can do!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (I've never felt more fantast-erific! Now I just gotta keep this up…)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: B-but…

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan A
text_block_list.text: Doesn't Yukino Bijin look even cuter in person than on TV?

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan B
text_block_list.text: Absolutely! Her skin's perfect! I bet she looks good wearing any color! Although…

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan B
text_block_list.text: Did you see that other racer? She was, like, so powerful… I think her name was… Harp Alpha?

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ah, I know who you're talking about. She ran really well too. But Yukino's still my favorite!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I knew she was the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I just wish…

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: This is the first time I've watched a race on TV, but that Snow Angel was super cute!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: She sure was! Kinda makes me wanna go see her in person…

text_block_list.name: Passersby A and B
text_block_list.text: Let's go to the racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Good job today, Harp Alpha. I don't think I have to tell you this, but…

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: I know you have what it takes to win. Are you ready to prove that at the Japanese Oaks?

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text: I'll run like I always do. Winning will come naturally.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: That's what I want to hear. Let's get going. We have to start working on our strategy.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's a city girl if I've ever seen one.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And all the fans are totally into her.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Even b'fore the race, she just had this air of conf'dence to her. Talk about cool.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You know what, Trainer? I…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanna s'prise everyone, just like her.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I want ev'ryone talk'n about how good I run!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: When I debuted, all I could think about was how diff'cult it was and how I wasn't good enough…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But now… I think I've got what it takes!
choice_data_list: Then let's prove it at the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Righty-o!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next race is the second leg of the Tiara tour, the Japanese Oaks. I'm sure that Yukino Bijin will give a spectacular performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't help but note the discrepancy between what Yukino Bijin wants for herself and what the media seems to be expecting.
